description: Master's studies focused on embedded computing, computer architecture, digital design, synthesis and optimization of microelectronic systems, and hardware/software co-design.

Developed SoC-based FPGA hardware and firmware for high-precision analog signal analysis. Designed a dynamically configurable FFT pipeline on a Zynq-7020, integrating signal conditioning, a custom Hann window, downsampling, Xilinx FFT IP, and high-speed result processing.

Worked on unit-level verification of RISC-V cache subsystems, focusing on cache coherency, consistency, and the TileLink2 protocol. Developed synthesizable assertions and automated emulation-based debugging and test monitoring workflows.
